summary: U.S. equities extended their rally on Monday with the Nasdaq hitting a fresh record high, climbing 1.1% as mega-cap tech led gains and investors looked past elevated Treasury yields and oil prices near $100. The S&P 500 rose 0.7% to close at 7,774 while the Dow added 91 points. Markets are now focused on Wednesday's release of the September FOMC minutes, which will shed light on the Fed's rationale for its September 25-basis-point rate hike—the first since 2023—and gauge the appetite for further tightening. Odds of an October hike have collapsed to just 17%, but futures still price in an 83% chance of at least one more move by December. In crypto, Bitcoin ETFs posted $90 million in outflows on Monday despite BTC holding near $86,000, with BlackRock's IBIT absorbing $70 million in inflows while ARK and Fidelity saw sharp redemptions. Ethereum continues to trade sideways above $2,700 amid persistent ETF outflows. On the M&A front, Schneider Electric agreed to acquire PTC for $22.6 billion and C.H. Robinson will buy RXO for $5.8 billion, signaling continued corporate dealmaking despite uncertainty around Fed policy.

signals.title: Nasdaq hits record high on mega-cap tech strength
signals.desc: Tech-heavy Nasdaq closed at all-time high of 27,477 on Monday as Nvidia and Microsoft rallied, signaling continued institutional demand for AI leaders ahead of Q3 earnings season.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs see $90M outflows as institutional appetite narrows
signals.desc: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $90 million in net outflows Monday with ARK losing $85M and Fidelity down $75M, indicating profit-taking despite BTC holding $86K levels.

signals.title: FOMC minutes Wednesday to clarify Fed's tightening path
signals.desc: September meeting minutes due 2pm ET will reveal divisions on further rate hikes after the Fed's unanimous 25bp increase, with markets pricing only 17% odds of October move.

signals.title: M&A wave continues as Schneider buys PTC for $22.6B
signals.desc: Schneider Electric's all-cash acquisition of industrial software firm PTC and C.H. Robinson's $5.8B RXO deal signal strong corporate dealmaking appetite despite macro uncertainty.

signals.title: Treasury yields remain elevated near multi-decade highs
signals.desc: 10-year Treasury yields hovering near 19-year peaks continue to cap upside for risk assets and pressure crypto, with markets pricing Fed rates near 4.7% into late 2027.

verdict: Tech leadership and M&A momentum support risk-on positioning into Wednesday's FOMC minutes, but elevated yields and crypto ETF outflows suggest caution as Fed tightening cycle remains unfinished.
